content.text: The blockchain does not have a map of restricted countries. A wallet address in Lagos processes a transaction identically to one in London. This is the operational reality that creators across Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines are using right now to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-everything-you-2|Digital Product]] products to a global audience. The infrastructure exists. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront. NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-broken-here-infrastructure-2|payment]]s verifies the payment on-chain and fires a webhook automatically. The product delivers before the buyer closes their wallet. The only question is whether you have assembled the stack correctly.
